name: CheckboxGroup
summary: A group of checkboxes with a label, a description and an error, that keeps the list of what is checked.

a11y.keyboardNote: role=group named by the label; description and error in aria-describedby. Each checkbox is a native input: Tab moves between them, Space toggles.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the label, read by screen readers with the group.

props.name: error
props.description: The error at the end; each checkbox gets aria-invalid.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The values of the checked boxes. Each Checkbox inside says its own value.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of every checkbox, for the form.

props.name: required
props.description: The red asterisk after the label, like Field.
